articles.title: The AI Music Backlash: Why Young Listeners Are Tuning Out Robot Tunes
articles.summary: A Luminate report reveals a sharp decline in comfort with AI-generated music, especially among Gen Z and Gen Alpha. While 44% of daily uploads on Deezer are AI tracks, they account for under 3% of real streams. Artists like SZA call it a 'war' against authentic music.

articles.title: Gotta Catch 'Em All—Even the Fossils! Pokémon Exhibit Digs into Real Science
articles.summary: The Pokémon Fossil Museum makes its North American debut at Chicago's Field Museum on May 22, 2026. The exhibit pairs real fossils with Pokémon like Aerodactyl, letting visitors compare ancient creatures with their fictional counterparts. It runs through April 2027.

articles.title: Sinner Makes History: Five Straight Masters Titles and Counting
articles.summary: Jannik Sinner crushed Alexander Zverev 6-1, 6-2 in 58 minutes to win the Madrid Open, becoming the first man to claim five consecutive Masters 1000 titles. The 24-year-old Italian extended his winning streak to 23 matches and now eyes the French Open.
